How Buildly works

A simpler way to connect construction needs with the right people.

Buildly brings project owners and contractors together in one place—from house repairs and renovations to new builds and specialized construction work.

Get StartedBack to Buildly

The Buildly connection

One place for construction requirements and opportunities.

01Project owners describe the work, location, scope and optional budget.
02Contractors showcase their company, skills, services, portfolio and capacity.
03Relevant contractors discover projects and can express interest or provide an initial estimate.
04Clients review, shortlist and connect with the contractors they prefer.
The Buildly workflow

From construction requirement to connection.

Buildly is designed to organize the process of discovering construction opportunities and potential service providers.

01

Describe the Project

Project owners can describe the construction requirement, scope of work, location, preferred schedule, photos and budget when available.

02

Build Your Profile

Contractors can create a professional profile and showcase their company or individual capabilities, services, skills, experience and completed projects.

03

Discover Opportunities

Contractors can discover projects that match their services, skills, experience, service areas and available capacity.

04

Respond & Estimate

When a project fits, contractors can express interest, provide an initial response or estimate, and start a conversation with the client.

05

Review & Shortlist

Project owners can review contractor profiles, services, experience, portfolios and initial responses.

06

Connect

Clients and suitable contractors can move forward by discussing the project directly and determining the next steps.

For Project Owners

Start with the requirement—not the contractor list.

Whether you need a leaking roof repaired, a room renovated, an electrical system upgraded, or a new house constructed, Buildly is designed to help you describe what you need and find relevant professionals.

P

Post

Describe your project, scope, location, photos, preferred schedule and budget if available.

D

Discover

Review contractors based on services, skills, experience, portfolio and service areas.

C

Compare & Connect

Review responses and initial estimates, shortlist suitable providers, then discuss the project directly.

For Contractors

Turn your capabilities into project opportunities.

Buildly gives contractors and construction professionals a dedicated place to present their experience and discover projects that match their services and capacity.

P

Professional Profile

Present your company or individual profile, services, skills, experience, portfolio and service areas.

O

Find Opportunities

Discover construction requirements that may fit your capabilities and available capacity.

R

Respond

Express interest, provide an initial response or estimate, and begin a conversation with the project owner.

Buildly MVP

Build smarter. Connect better.
